Menu.Name: Google Fonts
Menu.Label: Manage Google Fonts
Menu.Hint: Pick Google Fonts and choose where Foundry uses them (interface, headings, canvas, dice).

Manager.Title: Google Fonts
Manager.FontsHint: Type a family name exactly as shown on fonts.google.com (e.g. Cinzel, Noto Sans Thai) or paste a font page URL. Added fonts also appear in the text editor, drawings, and the Dice So Nice font list.
Manager.Preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 1234567890
Manager.NoDsn: Dice So Nice is not active, so the dice font setting has no effect.

Roles.UiHint: Sidebar, windows, sheets, chat, and journal body text.
Roles.Heading: Heading font
Roles.CanvasHint: Token nameplates, scrolling text, measurement labels, and the default for new drawings.
Roles.DiceHint: Used on 3D dice for any player whose dice font is set to Auto. Players can also pick any added font in their Dice So Nice settings.

ForceAll.Name: Force everywhere
ForceAll.Hint: Override fonts set by game systems and other modules too (icons and code are left alone). Turn on if some text keeps its old font.

Subsets.Name: Preloaded character sets
Subsets.Hint: Comma-separated Google subsets to load up front for canvas and dice text, e.g. latin, latin-ext, thai, cyrillic, greek, vietnamese.

DisableUi.Name: Disable Google interface fonts on this device
DisableUi.Hint: Keep Foundry's default interface fonts for you only. Canvas, dice, and editor fonts are unaffected.

Notify.NotFound: Could not find "{family}" on Google Fonts. Check the spelling and capitalization, and your internet connection.
